# PR #180 merge-delta correctness verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `8790154bbbe3db0297011c00cebb49739ea283ba`.

Delta only from the previously reviewed `0ffb88381f6ea11ed6d8816affe2b20b238d7621`: one merge of main/#175. This is not a fresh whole-PR review of #175.

- The digest footer names both stale extensions and lapsed native receivers, alongside stale cards and refused pane taps.
- fleet() appends stale_extensions and then lapsed_receivers; neither replaces the other. Both detector functions and their tests remain present.
- The API's Needs-a-look list and the PA brief retain both anomaly descriptions. The difficulties ledger retains F124 while adding F113.
- The Copilot store module changes only its extensionBuildIdentity helper to carry main's tree stamp. F124's queue/processing-before-uncertainty, wait/no-resend behavior and hard-hold stop code are unchanged. progress.test.mjs and the Rust delivery/lease/transport code are unchanged from the prior head.

Exact-head CI [42452702429](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42452702429) passed. Node 24 explicitly passes all three F124 replay/wait/escalation cases; its main native suite reports 333 passed/zero failures. JUnit artifact 13605668666 contains **2210 cases, zero failures/errors**, including the stale-extension detector, its parser controls, lapsed-native-receiver detector and native lease-expiry/transport regression.

The prior nonblocking N001 remains: no executed no-resend-veto/heartbeat-stop mutant or post-hard-hold heartbeat assertion was added by this merge. Do not expand the proof claim.

No merge-induced regression found in the scoped composition. The footer resolution adds no loop or launch. Checkout is clean/detached and matches the remote full head; GitHub reports CLEAN. No local Cargo/tests, live probe, dependencies, daemon action or product edits were performed.
